title: Secret of the Knights
author: Jim Gasperini, SD Separa
description:
IT IS THE YEAR 1340.

You have traveled back to the age of knights.

A squire has just accused you of being a sorcerer. You must prove yourself in a duel with quarterstaves, but you've never used them before.

You can try to defend yourself or escape through the angry crowd. Your decision can lead you to safety or leave you stranded in time!

ARE YOU READY TO FACE THE DANGER?

An unofficial adaptation of the 1984 Time Machine book by Jim Gasperini
